items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1958-08-08; 1958-09-03
items.q: The interviewee discusses the origin of his nickname 'Montutti' in response to the interviewer's mention of 'Fess', but does not describe any personal interaction, collaboration, or relationship with Fess himself.

ctx.x: So you're a little older than Fess then, about four years. I was going to ask while I think of it, that name Montutti, where did you ever get that name?

Well, I got that name. I'll tell you what we got that name. We used to play in the cafe, you know, nightclub. And this old guy used to come to hear us play. Pretty nice thought. He'd give us lots of tips, you know. And that was his name. They called him Montutti. Well, I was learning that name Montutti is called Duke. I don't know. Well, anyhow, O'Re and the boys, all this stuff. When the guy come in late, they say, come on there, old Montutti. You look just like Montutti. Well, they'd laugh at all. Johnny does,…
